text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 电影场景第2批 · 18 · 放学后的乡村教室.
Environment:  An original small historic New England village classroom after lessons, cream plaster, tall sash windows on left with early summer greenery outside, two short rows of worn honey-brown wood desks with closed plain notebooks. Simple teacher's table at rear, muted slate-gray chalkboard with very faint abstract chalk traces but no readable writing, blank rolled map, small vase of field flowers. Wide central aisle, doorway foreground creates depth, soft bright window fill, tactile youthful everyday warmth. No portraits, school crests or dolls.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent multi-angle image sheet with 4 clearly separated views of the same location. Show complementary eye-level views and relevant close details. Maintain the same physical positions of entrances, windows, stairs, furniture and landmark objects across views; no mirrored rearrangement. Small A/B/C/D labels only.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Create one spatial reference image for 电影场景第2批 · 18 · 放学后的乡村教室. Image1 is exact visual style and scene identity reference. Image2 is the spatial layout authority. Preserve same single location, all door/window/landmark/furniture relationships. Unseen sides may be reconstructed conservatively. A 2x2 sheet of FOUR distinct eye-level camera views of the SAME ONE space: original forward direction, a lateral oblique view, a reverse view 180 degrees opposite, and the other lateral view. Labels A B C D only. Preserve ALL door/window/furniture positions; actually move camera, never mirror the building. Same material and lighting. No people, animals, human pictures or silhouettes. No invented numbers/dimensions. Preserve original materials, palette and lighting. No added rooms or unrelated locations.
